description: Governance coverage ledger for every specification that steers Datum development. Enforced by scripts/check_spec_governance.py (wired into scripts/run_drift_gates.sh). Every .md under enforced_globs plus every tracked_doc and authority_doc MUST have an entry. Each entry needs only a 'class' — 'governed' (active spec), 'doctrine' (ratified decision record, controlling), 'pending' (known orphan awaiting disposition), 'historical' (superseded/frozen) — plus optional reason/notes fields. Behavioral enforcement lives in the proof gates and write-fence gates, not in per-doc ledger prose. See CLAUDE.md -> 'Specification Governance (controlling)'.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_027_FUL.notes: Amends decision 024 to require a fully fledged daily-driver embedded terminal with exclusive PTY screen truth, complete native UX/protocol/security/accessibility coverage, and verified Datum CLI/MCP/code-agent operation. Decision 029 requires the terminal core and PTY/session implementation to be Datum-owned.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_028_TER.notes: Extends decision 027 FT-009 with native client adapters, protected discovery, standard MCP primitives, pinned context and revision fences, scoped authority, portable workflow parity, and product round-trip proof.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_029_DEP.notes: Reserves new third-party dependency authority to an explicit numbered owner decision, freezes the inherited direct-dependency baseline, and requires Datum-owned terminal emulation and PTY/session source with no external fallback.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_030_DAT.notes: Ratifies a std-only first-party datum-terminal-core crate, clean-room standards process, governed Unicode data, bounded-resource semantics, truthful capability identity, per-slice proof, one-way cutover, source-health module boundaries, and conductor-controlled execution.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_031_TER.notes: Ratifies JetBrains Mono Regular as the terminal-cell-only typography exception for box-drawing and core Powerline coverage, with the exact vendored OFL asset and provenance; all non-cell chrome and EDA text remain IBM Plex, and no code dependency or terminal implementation is authorized.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_032_DAT.notes: Ratifies a std-only Datum-authored Linux D-Bus/AT-SPI accessibility bridge while rejecting AccessKit, libatspi, D-Bus crates, copied bindings/source, helper subprocesses, and any new third-party package; TerminalCore remains the sole terminal semantic authority.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_033_OUT.notes: Ratifies the output-only Datum Console, focused-pane Candidate-A overlay, bounded history with journal projection, consequence-based routing, accessibility boundary, and independence from the GUI write path; retires interactive Console input and adds no dependency.

docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_034_PRO.notes: Ratifies the standalone Datum Product Revision Engine, two-clock identity model, CI/baseline/change/release/document authority, optional subordinate Git adapter, exact impact/reproducibility rules, approved visual contract, and design-first non-blocking invariant; adds no dependency or implementation authorization.
